CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation is explicitly and unambiguously bound to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (identified red positions), an organization/presentation (explicit position set covering the grid), and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to p0/current/n1.

A.rationale: The text includes processing labels (e.g. "candidate", "inherited_current", origin kinds) but does not explicitly link an attention/allocation condition to the same content's organization/access in an unambiguous way.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit represented-content entries identify content (color) and positions (attributes).

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is stated separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing content identification from a status/origin attribute.

O.rationale: An explicit organized presentation/pattern is given (a full-grid set of positions for the content), describing how the content is represented/presented.
